pr_title: Fix ended session when there isn't any response from the user

<!--

  maintainers why we should accept this pull request. If it fixes a bug
  or resolves a feature request, be sure to link to that issue in the

* Add treatment of ended session when there isn't any response from the user
* Prevent from sending "reprompt" when its text evaluates to falsy value

## Type of change

## Additional information
<!--
  Details are important, and help maintainers processing your PR.
  Please be sure to fill out additional details, if applicable.
-->
https://developer.amazon.com/en-US/docs/alexa/custom-skills/request-types-reference.html#sessionendedrequest

https://github.com/home-assistant/core/pull/65256 introduced "reprompt" that keeps the session open for awhile in order to wait some response from the user.
It is working very well except when there isn't any response. This PR fixes it.

issue_context.title: Treatment of ended session when reprompting answer from user
issue_context.body:
### The problem Currently, when "reprompt" is sent and none response is given, Alexa responds: "There was a problem with the requested skill's response." It happens because there isn't any treatment for the "SessionEndedRequest" request. The current implementation returns `None`. There was a PR #69347 that would fix it, but I closed it. I will create another one today with updated code. Maybe this time there will be any interest in reviewing it as @ochlocracy is inactive for personal reasons. There are some examples in the `Additional information` block. ### What version of Home Assistant Core has the issue? core-2022.4.7 ### What was the last working version of Home Assistant Core? _No response_ ### What type of installation are you running? Home Assistant OS ### Integration causing the issue Alexa, Intent Script ### Link to integration documentation on our website https://www.home-assistant.io/integrations/intent_script/ https://www.home-assistant.io/integrations/alexa/ ### Diagnostics information _No response_ ### Example YAML snippet ```yaml It is in the additional information ``` ### Anything in the logs that might be useful for us? _No response_ ### Additional information | YAML | Expected | Actual | Result | |---|---|---|---| | 
IntentExample:
  speech:
    text: "test"
| * Set "speech" only
* Session ended successfully | * Set "speech" only
* Session ended successfully | OK | | 
IntentExample:
  speech:
    text: "test"
  reprompt:
    text: ""
| * Set "speech" only
* Session ended successfully | * Set "speech" only
* Session ended successfully | OK | | 
IntentExample:
  speech:
    text: "test"
  reprompt:
    text: "test"
| * Set "speech" and "reprompt"
* Wait response
* Session ended successfully | * Set "speech" and "reprompt"
* Wait response
* Session ended successfully (*) | Missing treatment of ended session when there isn't any response from the user ([Alexa](https://github.com/home-assistant/core/blob/f7b96c87d02eb520bbdc9e30ff0c89b137d6b663/homeassistant/components/alexa/intent.py#L130)) | | 
IntentExample:
  speech:
    text: "test"
  reprompt:
    text: '{{ "" }}'
| * Set "speech" only
* Session ended successfully | * Set "speech" and "reprompt"
* Wait response
* Session ended successfully (*) | Prevent from sending "reprompt" ([Intent Script](https://github.com/home-assistant/core/blob/f7b96c87d02eb520bbdc9e30ff0c89b137d6b663/homeassistant/components/intent_script/__init__.py#L102)) | | 
IntentExample:
  speech:
    text: "test"
  reprompt:
    text: '{{ "test" }}'
| * Set "speech" and "reprompt"
* Wait response
* Session ended successfully | * Set "speech" and "reprompt"
* Wait response
* Session ended successfully (*) | Missing treatment of ended session when there isn't any response from the user ([Alexa](https://github.com/home-assistant/core/blob/f7b96c87d02eb520bbdc9e30ff0c89b137d6b663/homeassistant/components/alexa/intent.py#L130)) | (*) Session is ended properly when the user answers the question.

review_comments:
We get this response because `amzn1.echo-sdk-ams.app.000000-d0ed-0000-ad00-000000d00ebe.SessionEndedRequest` is not a supported intent.

According to the docs there shouldn't be any response: https://developer.amazon.com/en-US/docs/alexa/custom-skills/request-types-reference.html#valid-response-types-2

Are the docs wrong, and this a useful response that we want to send back?
Is it correct to interpret a `SessionEndedRequest` as an intent, or should it have its own handler?

I just tried to follow the pattern as there is an **special intent** with the `application id` to capture [LaunchRequest](https://github.com/home-assistant/core/blob/1d68934ae25821851ec7ed70e106a398337fb7a6/homeassistant/components/alexa/intent.py#L150), and not just the string `LaunchRequest`.
https://www.home-assistant.io/integrations/alexa.intent/#support-for-launch-requests

So I just followed the pattern for [SessionEndedRequest](https://github.com/home-assistant/core/commit/3146c001e83e16b0c99eab31078e167f42a553d2#diff-6a4361e5c0693eb9fb08193a576fd791f770af510479615982aaf8bc6e16fecdR149)... `application id + "." + type`
Also, I thought it might be possible to handle multiple application ids in the future.
That is the reason why I didn't just use the string `SessionEndedRequest` as the intent.

Capturing `SessionEndedRequest` is useful to let us define a default action when there isn't any response in time, as the intent may be composed of a list of actions.
https://www.home-assistant.io/integrations/intent_script/#action

Just for reference: https://github.com/keatontaylor/alexa-actions/blob/ae3d9e43983462faacd11df31a3079db4f2201ea/lambda/lambda_function.py#L322
The example above returns a pseudo intent called "ResponseNone".

Currently, I have the following generic code:
https://gist.github.com/w35l3y/fa7086172c441fdaec9cd1f0d4f72e36
| Intent | Behavior | Status |
|---|---|---|
| LaunchRequest | Sends `speech` and `reprompt` based on the content of a `input_text` | Working |
| AMAZON.YesIntent | Sends `speech` and emits an event with positive response to be captured by an automation. | Working |
| AMAZON.NoIntent | Sends `speech` and emits an event with negative response to be captured by an automation. | Working |
| SessionEndedRequest | Emits an event with fallback response based on the content of a `input_text` to be captured by an automation. | Waiting this PR |

Oh, you mean the purpose is to make it possible to handle `SessionEndedRequest` in scripts?

If that's the case, please open a documentation PR which adds an example to https://www.home-assistant.io/integrations/alexa.intent.
I also think a test case asserting that such a script is working, instead of just a test case for when there's no handler would be helpful.

The purpose is to fix the current response that is "There was a problem with the requested skill's response."
Instead, it will return "This intent is not yet configured within Home Assistant."

English is not my native language, but I will try my best to write something good this weekend, ok?

> it will return "This intent is not yet configured within Home Assistant."

OK so the Alexa docs is misleading, it's actually possible to send a response back?
But my understanding is correct in that with your PR it's possible to handle `SessionEndedRequest` in a script/automation, but without your PR it's not possible?

> English is not my native language, but I will try my best to write something good this weekend

Yeah, that's perfectly fine, someone will help with the language/grammar if needed 👍

Yes, that is right.
According to Alexa docs, it is possible to handle `SessionEndedRequest`.

For reference:
[Request Types Reference - SessionEndedRequest](https://developer.amazon.com/en-US/docs/alexa/custom-skills/request-types-reference.html#sessionendedrequest)
[Developing Your First Skill - SessionEndedRequest handler](https://developer.amazon.com/en-US/docs/alexa/alexa-skills-kit-sdk-for-python/develop-your-first-skill.html#sessionendedrequest-handler)

Before this PR, when Alexa is waiting some voice response and nothing is said in time (+- 5 to 8 seconds), it sends `SessionEndedRequest` to Home Assistant that returns [None](https://github.com/home-assistant/core/blob/692a602aeabc2f11dfed9bdb7d6ac2acd20bde8d/homeassistant/components/alexa/intent.py#L132), an error message ("There was a problem with the requested skill's response.") and doesn't allow us to handle the request.
This PR allows us to handle it properly.

Added an example to the docs: https://github.com/home-assistant/home-assistant.io/pull/22908

Do you consider it resolved?

https://github.com/home-assistant/core/issues/72153
Blocks 2 and 4 of the `Additional information` are examples of falsy values.
Blocks 3 and 5 of the `Additional information` are examples of truthy values.
Blocks 1 of the `Additional information` is an example of undefined "reprompt".

https://docs.python.org/3/library/stdtypes.html?highlight=truth#truth-value-testing

It should call line 105 if and only if `reprompt` is defined and its text evaluates to truthy value.

If you help me with 1 example for this case, I can replicate to the other ones this weekend.

I think it is pacified that code won't need to change, as I already added a test as requested.
